title: Clockwork Chimes
tagline: Mesh brass gears; their pegs strike chimes in gear-ratio rhythms.
how_to: Tap to wind it, pick a gear size, drag it against another gear, tap a gear to change its pegs. Sound on.
description: A tiny clockwork music box you build yourself. Gears with real meshing teeth turn each other at true ratios, and each peg that passes the top strikes a bell. Mix tooth counts and peg numbers and listen to the rhythms drift in and out of step.
spark: Taken literally: a working clockwork of interlocking gears driven by a winding-key motor.
proud_of: Every placed gear is phase-aligned so its teeth truly interleave with its neighbour's, and turning ratios are exact.
